parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for reporting this. I’m sorry the v2.8 upgrade has caused your Salesforce production sync to fail. I understand this is critical and is currently blocking reporting for ~40 enterprise customers, and that you have a renewal call tomorrow.

We’ve escalated this for urgent engineering review. To help the team troubleshoot the auth token refresh errors quickly, could you please share the following minimum details:
1) Environment scope: is this only in production, or also in sandbox/dev?
2) The exact auth token refresh error(s) from the logs (error code/message text) and the timestamps when failures began (approx. time after the v2.8 upgrade).
3) For the affected Salesforce connection(s): which auth mechanism/provider is configured (e.g., OAuth connected app) and whether the issue affects all objects/data types or only specific ones.
4) Current sync state: last successful sync time (if known), and whether retries are occurring continuously.

If you can paste the relevant log excerpts here (redacting secrets), we’ll use them to investigate and advise on next steps as quickly as possible. In the meantime, please avoid making additional auth/credentials changes unless engineering requests it, since that can make tracing the failure window harder.
